name: rail_accidents
description: US train accidents and derailments reported to the Federal Railroad Administration (FRA Form 54, 1975–present). Returns individual rail equipment accident reports — derailments, train collisions, obstruction and other impacts — with date, reporting railroad (e.g. UP, BNSF, CSX, NS, Amtrak), accident type, FRA primary cause code and description (e.g. H702 "Switch improperly lined", T110 "Wide gage"), state and county, train speed, hazmat cars released, people evacuated, killed, injured and damage cost. Newest first. Filter by year, state, railroad, cause code or accident type. Use for "train derailments in Ohio in 2023", "Norfolk Southern accidents", "rail accidents caused by broken rails".

year.description: Calendar year of the accident (1975–present), e.g. 2023.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or full name, e.g. "OH" or "Ohio".

railroad.description: Reporting railroad: a reporting-mark code ("UP", "BNSF", "CSX", "NS", "ATK") or part of its name ("Norfolk Southern").

cause_code.description: FRA accident cause code or its prefix: "H702" exactly, or "T" for all track causes, "H" human factors, "E" equipment, "S" signal, "M" miscellaneous.

accident_type.description: Accident type text, matched as a substring: "Derailment", "Head on collision", "Rear end collision", "Side collision", "Raking collision", "Hwy-rail crossing", "Obstruction", "Fire/violent rupture", "Other impacts".

min_damage_usd.description: Only accidents with total reported damage at or above this amount in US dollars.

name: crossing_incidents
description: Highway-rail grade crossing collisions in the US — trains striking cars, trucks, pedestrians and cyclists at railroad crossings (FRA Form 57, 1975–present). Each incident carries the date, railroad, USDOT crossing id, state, county and city, road name, road user type and action (e.g. drove around gate, stopped on crossing), vehicle and train speed, crossing warning devices, weather, killed and injured. Newest first. Filter by state, county, city, year, railroad or a specific crossing id. Use for "railroad crossing accidents in Harris County Texas", "pedestrians hit by trains in California 2024", "incidents at crossing 812329E".

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or full name, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

county.description: County name, e.g. "Harris" (matched case-insensitively, "County" suffix optional).

city.description: City name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Houston".

railroad.description: Railroad reporting-mark code ("UP", "BNSF") or part of its name.

crossing_id.description: USDOT grade crossing inventory number, e.g. "812329E".

highway_user.description: Road user type, matched as a substring: "Auto", "Truck", "Truck-trailer", "Pick-up truck", "Pedestrian", "Bus", "Motorcycle", "Van", "Other motor vehicle".

fatal_only.description: Only incidents with at least one person killed.

name: rail_accident_summary
description: Counts and totals of FRA-reported US railroad accidents or grade crossing incidents, grouped by railroad, cause, accident type, state, year or road user. Returns per-group incident count, killed, injured and (for train accidents) damage cost. Use for "which railroads had the most derailments in 2023", "top causes of train accidents in Texas", "crossing deaths per year since 2015", "rail accident trend by year".

dataset.description: "accidents" = rail equipment accidents (Form 54, default); "crossings" = highway-rail grade crossing incidents (Form 57).

group_by.description: Grouping. "cause" and "accident_type" apply to accidents; "highway_user" to crossings; the rest to both.

from_year.description: Restrict to this year and later (use with group_by "year" for a trend).

state.description: Restrict to one US state (code or name).

railroad.description: Restrict to one railroad (reporting-mark code or name substring).
